_comment: Each job's 'values' come straight from the matching regex in signals_railway_signals.yaml (see the regex quoted in each job's own _source comment) - this file is the single list of 'which aspects to generate', kept next to the YAML regex it mirrors so the two can be checked against each other by eye. _source comments give only the tag/regex and whatever is specific to that job; the job mode (split/digits/fused) and its base+overlay-vs-fused wiring are already explained once in generate-aspects.mjs.
_lightColors: Color each class token lights its elements with, shared by every 'lights' job. O is the sighting light (oeilleton) and XF the background of the intermediate signal center lamp: an aspect lights them by listing them.

jobs.name: TIV-D_B
jobs._source: railway:signal:speed_limit_distant:fast:speed, regex ^([67]0|[89][05]|1[0-5][05]|1[6-9]0)$

jobs.name: TIV-D_C
jobs._source: railway:signal:speed_limit_distant:railcar:speed, regex ^([4-7]0|[89][05]|1[0-5][05]|160)$

jobs.name: TIV-R
jobs._source: railway:signal:speed_limit:switchable:speed, regex ^([2-4]|[6-9]|1[0-6])0$ (also covers the narrower :speed_limit_reminder:speed legacy regex) - 2-digit values, font-size matches the non-suffixed template

jobs.name: TIV-R
jobs._source: railway:signal:speed_limit:switchable:speed - 3-digit values, font-size matches the _fast template (same base icon as the 2-digit job above: only font-size/position differ)

jobs.name: TIV-D_pentagonal
jobs._source: railway:signal:speed_limit_distant:freight:speed, regex ^[1-9]0$ - the plate only ever shows the tens digit (displayDivisor: 10), filename keeps the full value

jobs.name: TIV-E_pentagonal
jobs._source: railway:signal:speed_limit:freight:speed, regex ^[1-9]0$ - the plate only ever shows the tens digit (displayDivisor: 10), filename keeps the full value

jobs.name: TIV-D
jobs._source: TIV-D Mobile, illuminated box form - 2-digit values, font-size matches the non-suffixed template; no separate base layer in the YAML

jobs.name: TIV-D
jobs._source: TIV-D Mobile, illuminated box form - 3-digit values, font-size matches the _fast template (same base icon as the 2-digit job above: only font-size/position differ)

jobs.name: TIV-R
jobs._source: TIV-R Mobile, illuminated box form, regular (non-wide) width - 2-digit values. Each digit is its own <text> element in the SNCF-Lightbox glyph font. No separate base layer in the YAML: 'fr/boxes/TIV-R_open' remains the no-match fallback; 'fr/boxes/TIV-R' off icon confirmed unused.

jobs.name: TIV-R
jobs._source: TIV-R Mobile, illuminated box form, wide variant for 3-digit values - genuinely different (wider) shape, not just a font-size tweak. Overlay filenames are shared with the regular-width job above ('fr/boxes/TIV/TIV-R_{}' covers both digit counts in the YAML), hence the same job.name; no `base` since each file already carries its own shape.

jobs.name: L_uncoupling
jobs._source: railway:signal:coupling:length (2TMV) - PROVISIONAL: no official value list confirmed yet, reusing the L... plate's standard lengths as a placeholder. Filed next to the L... plates (signs/L), named L{v}_uncoupling.

jobs.name: L_RBT
jobs._source: railway:signal:stop:any:length, regex ^[0-9]+$ (Pancarte L... RBT) - matches 'fr/signs/L/L_{}_RBT'. Known values: 50|80|120|160|200.

jobs.name: V
jobs._source: railway:signal:stop:conventional:number, 1-digit case (1-9), drawn from the V.svg template. Confirmed by Noel: V_1digit/V_2digit are retired, V/V_long are the live names in both the template files and the YAML.

jobs.name: V
jobs._source: railway:signal:stop:conventional:number, 2-digit case (10-19), drawn from the V_long.svg template (two separately-positioned <text> elements, one per digit, kept separate rather than merged into a single tspan since there is no room to display both digits as one string).

jobs.name: V_U-turn
jobs._source: railway:signal:stop:conventional:number, 1/2-train U-turn sign ('1/2 t' = demi-tour, drawn as a fixed vector shape, not literal <text>), regex widened from ^[56]$ to ^[1-9]$ per the simplification to 1-19 vehicles. No `base` field: Noel hand-draws 'fr/signs/V_U-turn_empty' himself (confirmed present on disk, directly under signs/, matching the YAML default and the sibling 'fr/signs/V_empty') - the tool must not auto-generate or overwrite it.

jobs.name: V
jobs._source: railway:signal:stop:conventional:number, 2-number split case (replaces the old hardcoded pair enumeration), top/bottom share consecutive ranges - path matches the YAML's layer-1 case value 'fr/signs/V_split' (no V/ subfolder)
